chapter_path_zh: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
display_chapter_path: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
stem: 国家风险评估(NRA)和行业风险评估如何影响金融机构(FI)的内部反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义(AML/CFT)风险评估？

options.A: 金融机构必须证明其在反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义风险评估中所识别的风险与国家风险评估和行业风险评估相一致,并且这些风险得到了有效管理.
options.B: 若发布了行业风险评估报告,金融机构必须直接将其应用于所有子公司和分支机构,不得进行任何修改.
options.C: 金融机构的反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义风险评估必须完全按照国家风险评估和行业风险评估的规定编写，并经董事会批准。
options.D: 金融机构必须严格采用国家风险评估和行业风险评估中确定的确切风险因素

stem_en: How do national risk assessments (NRAs) and sectoral risk assessments influence a financial institution's (FI's) internal AML/CFT risk assessment?

options_en.A: An FI must demonstrate that the risks identified in its AML/CFT risk assessment are aligned with the NRA and sectoral risk assessments and that these risks are managed effectively
options_en.B: If a sectoral risk assessment is published, the FI must implement it directly across all subsidiaries and branches without modification
options_en.C: An FI's AML/CFT risk assessment must be written and approved by the board of directors exactly as specified in the NRA and sectoral risk assessment
options_en.D: An FI must strictly adopt the exact risk factors identified in the NRA and sectoral risk assessments
